ingredientSections.heading: Candied Yam & Sweet Potato Soup with Brie

methodSections.heading: Candied Yam & Sweet Potato Soup with Brie
steps: Dice the yams/sweet potatoes, onions and garlic and mix with the sugar and whipping cream. Roast for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, add the cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla, lemon and orange juice to the chicken stock and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the roasted yams/sweet potatoes to the stock mixture.
Using a stick mixer, blend until smooth.
Bring to a simmer and serve hot.
Garnish generously with the dried cranberries and diced brie.
